caption: The drawing features a single metal object positioned horizontally and centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object consists of two circular bands, one on the left and one on the right, connected by a straight, solid bar. The bands and bar appear metallic, with shades of brown and subtle blue shadows giving a three-dimensional appearance. There is a small protrusion at the center where the bar meets each band. The background is unmarked except for a small, neat inscription slightly to the right below the object that reads "Ali Dora." The composition is minimal, with the object prominently displayed in the center and ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Handcuffs
